context_files.purpose: Exact V8 proposal and 126 rows under critique.
Binding V8 integration obligations, including V8IR018.
Exact registry, DAG, lattice, CAS, visibility, and release source.

strongest_case: V8 preserves exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP, keeps parenting and repetition on the waking-child route, narrows Delta_F and Delta_E to total-regime interactions, makes all results prospective, and correctly creates 21 families by six phases with 126 unique row and receipt identities. Atomic candidate closure, store-mediated promotion, split evaluation, finite action instances, and an explicit release chain are strong intended repairs. Adoption nevertheless requires V9 bytes: both scientific disagreements and all nine systems disagreements are real blockers. The alternate artifact strengthens that verdict because the same bound cores admit incompatible visibility universes and policies while both retain the same 126 IDs.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: rename Delta_R to the incremental correct-versus-none advice-use interaction, and permit the adjective selective only after a separately ratified DELTA_R_SELECTIVITY_DECISION_RECEIPT binds prospective irrelevant/wrong contrast estimands, simultaneous uncertainty, multiplicity, margins, analysis code, roots, and PASS.
concerns.evidence: Delta_R contains only T/D correct and none terms. Irrelevant and wrong are merely reported controls, so no frozen rule distinguishes selective uptake from compliance, perturbation, or asymmetric harm. This adopts V8SCI_D01.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: retain 21 families and 126 identities but extend ES07 STATIC_SCHEMA and G0_FAKE_RUNTIME with a typed scope-aware V8IR018 prohibition checker and mutation fixtures over bootstrap-contract, corpus, curriculum, habit, example, domain, row-count, dose, rank, and allocation fields; distinguish phase_count=6 from habit_count=6 and equality-bind the checker result in later applicable rows.
concerns.evidence: No V8 acceptance row names or tests the required prohibition on architecture-level 192 examples, six habits, six names, or 32-per-habit allocation. Mere absence from current bytes is not a prospective checker. This adopts V8SCI_D02.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: define one canonical concrete object identity and alias/equality table, eliminate category duplicates and deferred placeholders, expand every sealed sub-DAG instance before first effect, and specify access independently for each principal/object/value-count-order-timing-cache-retry-error tuple with same-verdict hyperproperty tests.
concerns.evidence: In the primary 60,705 base-object/stage groups, all seven channels always share one state: 56,744 all forbidden, 2,478 all visible, and 1,483 all derived_only. The matrix also repeats objects across artifact_definition, artifact_instance_class, receipt, produced_receipt, audit, release, and placeholder categories. The alternate instead grants roles only on value and yields 278,775 rather than 424,935 cells, proving the core does not determine least privilege. This adopts V8SYS_D01.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: use only BOOTSTRAP_SEMANTIC_CONTROL_AUDIT_RECEIPT and BOOTSTRAP_TARGET_BLINDNESS_AUDIT_RECEIPT; replace source-as-action X0_REGISTERED_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_STORE with a registered least-authority actor; model E5_LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE as caller and X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE as sole atomic producer of PROMOTION_TRANSACTION_RECEIPT and PROMOTE_CAS_RESULT; materialize exact closed request/result/denial schemas for every operation and issuance.
concerns.evidence: The family registry still names two unregistered evidence aliases, a fixed action treats a source as its executing principal, promotion products have the store as sole producer but the producing action has the gate principal, and most operation schemas are IDs without field bodies. This adopts every subpart of V8SYS_D02.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: classify every prerequisite as exact external/frozen issuance, fixed action result, or sealed-sub-DAG result; add missing lower-rank producer/join actions and equality-bind their concrete result roots into each fixed consumer; mechanically require one producer, reachability, lower rank, and acyclicity.
concerns.evidence: G0 results, implementation/review manifests, CPU/GPU manifests and scores, pre-GPU and powered evidence, independent review, visibility, and taint receipts appear as fixed prerequisites without a complete producer-action or generated-sub-DAG join path. Declared principal ownership is not reachability. This adopts V8SYS_D03.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: add an enumerated constructor action producing CANDIDATE_CLOSURE and CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE from birth, zero initializer, complete evidence, writer/support/coverage contracts, and seed; require the seal action to consume and equality-bind those exact products and every promised input before the store alone issues manifest, descriptor, result, and lineage fact.
concerns.evidence: A_V8_G2_SEAL_CANDIDATE_CLOSURE_ATOMIC omits candidate, trace, immutable birth, writer contract, and support contract prerequisites and has no constructor producer action, despite the operation prose promising to bind them. This adopts V8SYS_D04.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: replace transition target UNCHANGED with explicit self-transitions over every bound state; define canonical digest coverage and durable serialization; separate request-independent pre-admission denial from digest-bound terminal results or explicitly permit public-input echoes while proving all secret-dependent channels identical.
concerns.evidence: UNCHANGED is absent from the state enum. A result cannot both echo varying request_digest/idempotency_key and satisfy the claim that every failure has identical bytes and all seven public channels. This adopts V8SYS_D05.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: make GPU dispatch directly consume the six omitted roots CUMULATIVE_COVERAGE_FEASIBILITY_RECEIPT, D_T_M0_CONTROL_STRENGTH_RECEIPT, TARGET_BLIND_HELDOUT_CONSTRUCTION_RECEIPT, CONTAMINATION_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_RECEIPT, NO_RETRIEVAL_RECEIPT, and NATIVE_ACTION_CONTROL_RECEIPT; canonicalize reporter IDs to registered names; add ordered producers for every claim component, powered manifest, and independent evidence review before reporter, claim, external-science, or release use.
concerns.evidence: scientific_edges declares ten pre-GPU receipts but dispatch consumes only four; reporter prose names three aliases not registered as those identities; component and powered evidence lack a complete earlier producer chain. This adopts V8SYS_D06.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: issue three exact G0_ACTION_CHILD_AUTHORIZATION roots and require one on each G0 action; echo the child-authorization root and all harness roots in each result; assemble only the two pre-install results before gate installation, then emit the separately authorized install result and optionally assemble all three afterward, avoiding a self-prerequisite.
concerns.evidence: All three fixed G0 actions omit the child authorization promised by prose, G0_ECHO_CLOSED_RESULTS has no explicit producer action, and treating an aggregate containing the install result as an install prerequisite would be circular. This adopts V8SYS_D07.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: add direct predecessor or cumulative-manifest reachability across all eight release steps; produce and consume RELEASE_CHAIN_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST; equality-bind one nine-field external authority payload through verifier, wrapper, tuple binder, transfer request/result, and receipt; define exact TRANSFER_OPAQUE schemas and one-shot failure/idempotency behavior.
concerns.evidence: Lineage audit does not depend on the preceding blindness audit, RELEASE_CHAIN_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST is outside the path, and external authorization, action authority, tuple, wrapper, transfer, and receipt lack one executable equality chain. This adopts V8SYS_D08.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; ALL 126 IDS REVIEWED ABOVE. V9 REPAIR: preserve 21-by-6 unique identities but define phase-indexed constructible evidence/root sets; STATIC_SCHEMA receives definitions only, G0 fake receives fixtures/results, and later phases receive only already produced roots. Replace legacy global required_before with exact first-consumer IDs in a ratified schema version, distinguish G3 reporting/external science from G4 named claim/release, and issue __PASS only on PASS with a separate neutral/FAIL result identity.
concerns.evidence: Cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness pass for all 126 rows, but every family copies eventual typed evidence into all six phases, required_before conflicts with the integration contract and collapses G3/G4, and IDs ending __PASS allow pass_fail=FAIL. Thus none of the 126 rows is adoption-ready even though no ID is omitted. This adopts V8SYS_D09 and is the explicit disposition of every reviewed ID.

concerns.statement: ADOPTION BLOCKER; V9 REPAIR: designate one hash-bound normative generation algorithm and canonical identity policy, regenerate the proposal deterministically, and require any independent builder to reproduce the exact graph, loops, claims, 126 rows, visibility universe, cells, and proposal hash or fail with an enumerated discrepancy.

Validation accepts both, so exact source-to-proposal generation is underdetermined.

concerns.statement: V9 must preserve exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP and the waking-child-to-independent-eligibility route; this critique authorizes only consensus rework, never ratification, intake transition, implementation, execution, science, claim, publication, push, release, or transfer.
concerns.evidence: Both interpretations agree on the organism and authority boundary, and AGENTS.md requires consensus and exact human ratification before later work.

Category-qualified duplicates and deferred placeholders prevent one canonical concrete identity per runtime object.
The alternate grants role visibility only on value and produces a different universe, demonstrating underdetermined visibility policy.

Six declared pre-GPU scientific receipts are absent from GPU dispatch prerequisites.
G0 child authorization is prose-only, and the result aggregate lacks a noncircular producer path.
Candidate construction, powered evidence, reporter, release evidence, and several fixed prerequisites lack exact lower-rank producer reachability.
